Step 3 (Roles A Veterinarian Plays): You might not hear much about public health veterinariansbecause most of them work for local, state, and federal agencies (p. 22).
Step 4 (Roles A Veterinarian Plays): Veterinarians who work in public health are the silent sentinelsprotecting America's public health and our quality of life (p. 22).
